items.title: ET Wealth Expo: Why market veteran S Naren thinks investors are getting gold, silver and asset allocation all wrong
items.description: ICICI Prudential MF's S Naren warns investors against chasing assets after spectacular rallies, highlighting how silver's 216% surge drew record ETF inflows before a 27% correction. At the ET Wealth Expo, he explained why genuine asset allocation means buying unpopular assets and why gold still deserves a place in portfolios.

items.title: Diwali stock picks: SBI Securities lists 11 stocks with up to 22% upside potential. Do you own any?
items.description: As India prepares to celebrate Diwali next week, investors will welcome Samvat 2083 after a challenging year for equities.SBI Securities expects a gradual recovery after two years of consolidation. The primary catalyst for this recovery, according to the brokerage, will be a pullback in crude oil prices below $90 per barrel.“We remain optimistic about forward outlook and believe domestic equities are likely to deliver better returns on the back of double-digit earnings growth despite of vulnerable external environment, likely conclusion of trade deal between US-India, alongside India’s ongoing export basket diversification, reversal of global AI trade, which should redirect capital flows toward well diversified markets emerging markets like India and likelihood of continued reforms by the government to accelerate economic growth,” it said.Additionally, SBI Securities believes any relief in the taxation pertaining to STT or LTCG would serve as a big sentiment booster for equity markets. Going forward, it believes the sectors from where wealth creators are likely to emerge are auto OEMs and auto ancillaries, capital goods or Engineering, including defence, aerospace engineering, railway safety, power equipment, pharma ancillary, import substitution like CNC machine, BFSI, EMS, recycling, new age platform businesses, pharma - CDMO & chemicals, structural steel tubes, discretionary consumption (hotels, jewellery, alcoholic beverages etc.) and metals or mining.Also read | Diwali 2026: Sensex plunged 10,000 points, Nifty dropped 12% since last Diwali. Will Samvat 2083 bring some relief?Here are SBI Securities’ 11 Diwali stock picks

items.title: Sebi to release FII compliance consultation paper within weeks, says chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey
items.description: Sebi is likely to release a consultation paper on foreign investor compliance requirements within weeks, chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said. The proposed document will explore aligning Indian norms with global standards amid heavy FII outflows. The regulator is also planning a capacity-building network to strengthen independent directors’ effectiveness.

items.title: Dalal Street Weak Ahead: Nifty stands on firmer footing, but can it break past 23,450?
items.description: The Nifty gained 2% last week, recovering above the crucial 200-week moving average at 22,700. While easing volatility and buying at lower levels support the rebound, bearish momentum indicators suggest caution. Analysts identify 23,300–23,450 as immediate resistance and 22,750–22,525 as key support for the coming week.

items.title: Turnaround Story: 8 stocks shift from loss to profit in September '26 quarter
items.description: A "Turnaround Story YoY" indicates that a company has moved from reporting a net loss in the corresponding quarter last year to posting a net profit in the latest quarter, signalling a significant improvement in its financial performance. Within the Nifty 500 universe, we have highlighted eight stocks that reported a return to profitability in the September 2026 quarter, compared with losses in the year-ago quarter, based on StockEdge's profitability scan data.

items.title: ET Wealth Expo | Only 6 of 1990's Sensex stocks survive: S Naren's case for smarter asset allocation
items.description: S Naren of ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund highlights how only six companies from the 1990 Sensex remain in the benchmark today. At ET Wealth Expo, he explained why beaten-down stocks may never recover and urged investors to distinguish between asset allocation and stock selection, while cautioning against chasing strong past returns.

items.title: Sebi pushes for resilient capital markets, focuses on investor protection: Chairman
items.description: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey emphasized the importance of accessible and efficient capital markets at a recent forum. He highlighted the growth in market capitalisation with significant annual fundraising through equity and debt. The number of investors in West Bengal has dramatically increased, indicating regional market participation. Additionally, various steps have been taken to streamline compliance and fundraising processes for issuers.

items.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks that gain for 5 days in a row
items.description: Over the five trading sessions ended October 30, the Sensex advanced 1.8%, or 1,336 points, to close at 74,459, posting gains in four of the five sessions. Amid the broader market rally, around 18 stocks from the BSE 500 index rose in each of the five consecutive trading sessions between October 26 and 30. Of these, we identified eight stocks that gained on all five days, delivering cumulative returns ranging from 10% to 21% during the period. (Data Source: ACE Equity)
